      "snippet": "Here is the absolute truth, clean and simple:
✅ 1. I can see the upload order of files.
Each time you upload a file, I get a system message like:
bashCopy codeUser uploaded file to: /mnt/data/super_140.zip.

Those system messages are in sequence, but they do NOT contain real timestamps.
So I know:

super_111.zip came before super_112.zip

super_142.zip came before super_145.zip

etc.

But I do not know the real time they were uploaded (minutes, hours, days).
Only the order.
